items.headline: U.S. Futures Edge Higher as Bond Market Stabilizes and Oil Prices Ease
items.summary: U.S. stock futures are showing positive movement in pre-market trading this Friday, with indices poised for an upward open. This follows a period of bond market stabilization and a notable drop in oil prices, fueled by hopes of diplomatic progress regarding the Strait of Hormuz. Geopolitical risks in the Middle East and ongoing bond market volatility, however, continue to be closely monitored by investors.

items.headline: Apimeds Pharmaceuticals Surges on Strong Pre-market Activity
items.summary: Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US, Inc. ($APUS) experienced a significant pre-market rally, jumping 193.89% to $6.73, making it one of the largest gainers.

items.headline: Surrozen, Inc. Sees Substantial Pre-market Gains
items.summary: Surrozen, Inc. ($SRZN) climbed 85.64% to $30.00 in early trading, indicating strong investor interest.

items.headline: Akamai Jumps on Major Anthropic Deal
items.summary: Akamai ($AKAM) rose 21% in pre-market after securing an $11.6 billion deal with Anthropic.

items.headline: Artelo Biosciences Plunges in Pre-market Trading
items.summary: Artelo Biosciences, Inc. ($ARTL) dropped sharply by 33.38% to $4.87, facing significant selling pressure.

items.headline: Beneficient Experiences Steep Decline Pre-market
items.summary: Beneficient ($BENF) fell 33.10% to $1.94 during pre-market, marking it among the day's biggest losers.

items.headline: Nike Dips After Bank of America Downgrade
items.summary: Nike ($NKE) shares dipped over 2% in pre-market trading after BofA downgraded the stock to Underperform, citing a delayed sales recovery into fiscal 2028.

items.headline: Key Economic Data Releases Set for Friday
items.summary: Investors are awaiting several key economic data releases today, including the August Durable Goods Orders (preliminary) at 8:30 AM ET and the final September University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index at 10:00 AM ET. These reports will offer further insights into consumer confidence and manufacturing activity, influencing market direction.

items.headline: Oil Prices Retreat on Hopes of Hormuz Reopening
items.summary: Oil prices have pulled back on Friday, with Brent crude down 1.1% and West Texas Intermediate down 1.8%, driven by increasing hopes of diplomatic progress between the U.S. and Iran concerning the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. This potential de-escalation of geopolitical tensions is easing inflation concerns.

items.headline: U.S. Treasury Yields Ease Slightly After Volatile Week
items.summary: U.S. Treasury yields are showing signs of stabilization in early Friday trading, with the 10-year Treasury easing slightly to around 5.17% after hitting a 19-year high of 5.225% on Thursday. Elevated government bond yields have been a significant pressure point on equity markets due to inflationary pressures and rising U.S. government debt.

items.headline: U.S. and China Leaders Conclude Summit
items.summary: President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping are concluding their U.S. state visit today, with discussions covering trade, artificial intelligence, and the Middle East. President Trump emphasized building a relationship that promotes prosperity and security.
